name: Sedan
bestFor: Daily office pick-up and drop for 3–4 employees on a shared route; airport transfers for one or two guests.
notes: The workhorse of employee transport. Compact enough for inner-colony lanes in Kukatpally or Manikonda, efficient on ORR runs.

name: SUV
bestFor: Routes with 5–6 employees from one residential belt; small teams travelling together to client sites.
notes: Better occupancy per trip than a sedan, so fewer vehicles on a cluster route from Miyapur or LB Nagar.

name: Premium MUV
bestFor: Executive and client movement, long outstation drives and premium employee routes where comfort matters.
notes: Preferred for CXO airport runs on the PVNR Expressway and for Hyderabad–Vijayawada or Hyderabad–Bengaluru business trips.

name: Tempo Traveller
bestFor: Fixed-route shuttles between a metro station or hostel cluster and the office, and offsite or event movement.
notes: Ideal for Raidurg Metro ↔ Financial District or Miyapur ↔ Gachibowli shuttle loops where a sedan fleet would be wasteful.

name: Mini Bus
bestFor: Plant and warehouse shift transport, large office shuttles on trunk routes.
notes: Suits Balanagar, Jeedimetla and Patancheru shift runs where 20+ employees board from a few collection points.

name: Bus
bestFor: High-volume trunk routes and multi-point collection for manufacturing, pharma and large campuses.
notes: Lowest cost per seat when occupancy is steady; typical for Genome Valley and Pashamylaram plant rosters.

name: Electric Sedan
bestFor: Intra-corridor office routes under 150 km a day where companies want a lower-emission commute for ESG reporting.
notes: Works best on predictable HITEC City–Gachibowli–Financial District loops with depot charging between shifts.
